$comment: Advisories consciously accepted, with justification and a review date.
An entry here is a decision, not a mute button: scripts/audit.mjs fails the build
if an entry is past its reviewBy date, and warns when an entry is no longer needed
so the list cannot quietly become permanent cruft.

allow.title: RSC Mode CSRF Bypass Allows Action Execution Before 400 Response
allow.justification: Affects React Router's RSC (React Server Components) mode. GrandMate's frontend is a pure client-side SPA using createBrowserRouter with no RSC, no server actions, and no react-router server runtime, so the vulnerable code path is not reachable. There is no unaffected version available: every release from 7.12.0 carries this advisory, while 6.0.0-7.17.0 carries fourteen others including XSS, open redirect, and RCE via turbo-stream that DO affect client-side routing. 7.18.1 is strictly the safer choice.
